about: Amos is a city in Quebec’s Abitibi-Témiscamingue region, on the Rivière Harricana north of Val-d’Or and Rouyn-Noranda. Mining and forestry heritage, a bilingual service-hub role for the Abitibi, and northern boreal setting define the community. About 13,000 people live in Amos.
